_what: Battle-mode team A, second version (snatcherLeo, 2026-10-24: Mewtwo replaces Venusaur, holding Venusaur's Starf Berry). Otherwise as ebm_team_a.json: applied to the battle-mode card only, never snatcherLeo's story card; six Pokemon at Lv 50, every held item different, all moves from each species' level-up or TM/HM lists on the disc. Themes kept: the weather fight (Drizzle vs Drought), Intimidate, two-turn moves (Fly, Dig, Solar Beam without sun), Thrash, Hyper Beam's recharge, Spikes, Toxic, Surf and Earthquake, Bullet Seed, the no-story-source held items. Lost with Venusaur: Leech Seed and Sleep Powder. Mewtwo adds Thunder in and out of rain (Kyogre's comparison) and Shadow Ball.

add_pokemon._note: Kyogre (Drizzle), Modest: Surf, Ice Beam, Thunder (sure-hit in rain), Calm Mind; Sitrus Berry
Groudon (Drought), Adamant: Earthquake, Solar Beam (one turn in sun), Fire Blast, Dig (two-turn); Lum Berry
Gyarados (Intimidate), Adamant: Thrash (multi-turn), Dragon Dance (Lv 50), Earthquake (hits the partner too), Hyper Beam (recharge); Choice Band
Skarmory (Keen Eye), Adamant: Spikes (Lv 42), Fly (two-turn, HM02), Toxic, Protect; Shell Bell
Mewtwo (Pressure), Modest: Psychic, Thunder, Ice Beam, Shadow Ball (all TMs on the disc); Starf Berry (Venusaur's)
Ludicolo (Swift Swim), Modest: Rain Dance, Bullet Seed (multi-hit), Ice Beam, Protect; Persim Berry
